title: Reduce path formatter flat export
summary: Removed the display-only shortenPath flat formatter alias and moved Home, Queue, and Pending Publish consumers to mediaPipelineFormatters.shortenPath.
reason: WebView flat-export cleanup should reduce high-confidence transitional globals without changing backend-owned media or mutation behavior. shortenPath already lives on mediaPipelineFormatters and is used only for frontend path display shortening.
behavior_before: formatters.js exported shortenPath as a flat window alias, and Home, Queue, and Pending Publish display code consumed the helper through ambient flat-global access.
behavior_after: Home, Queue, and Pending Publish bind shortenPath from window.mediaPipelineFormatters with existing local fallback behavior, while formatters.js no longer publishes window.shortenPath. The remaining formatter flat aliases are unchanged.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_row_detail_smoke -q - failed in the existing row-detail jsdom fixture at pendingPublishView.confidence.js document.body.classList access before row-detail assertions; reproduced separately and unrelated to shortenPath namespace wiring
rollback_plan: Restore window.shortenPath assignment in formatters.js, switch Home/Queue/Pending Publish callers back to flat-global shortenPath access, regenerate the WebView public contract/global export inventory/summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView validation ladder.
notes:
Remove the display-only shortenPath flat alias while keeping mediaPipelineFormatters.shortenPath.
Use mediaPipelineFormatters.shortenPath for Home compact path display.
Use mediaPipelineFormatters.shortenPath for Pending Publish path displays and summary module dependency.
Use mediaPipelineFormatters.shortenPath for Queue table path display dependency.
Assert shortenPath flat alias stays removed.
Pin namespace-backed shortenPath wiring in Home, Queue, and Pending Publish assets.
Regenerate WebView public contract after shortenPath alias cleanup.
Sync flat export inventory after removing shortenPath alias.
Refresh generated summary after shortenPath flat-export cleanup.
This is frontend display formatting cleanup only; no backend routes, command journal behavior, confirmations, source-media access, pending-publish drain policy, settings persistence, queue mutation, or file movement changed.
